summary: An old hurt can make the next opportunity look dangerous for reasons that belong partly to what happened before.
body: An old hurt can make the next opportunity look dangerous for reasons that belong partly to what happened before. When Chiron squares the North Node, criticism, visibility, or entering a similar situation can bring an earlier experience back into the decision with far more authority than it deserves. The fear may still contain useful information about what needs protection now. Update the boundary or secure better support, but do not assume the only safe choice is avoiding anything that resembles the old problem.
